label: rem:discrete-vortex-physical
title: Vortex intensity levels as fluid-dynamical orbitals
html: The discrete vortex spectrum supports a direct physical interpretation. A stable vortex in the brane fluid cannot smoothly escalate its circulation; it must transition sharply between discrete intensity states. The \mathrm{SU}_q(2) ladder operators that yield fermionic matter in the weight-space decomposition govern these transitions. The resulting vortex intensity levels E_j^{(q)} serve as the fluid-dynamical analogue of atomic electron orbitals.
